description: This file contains React components for UI building blocks such as Pill, EmptyState, ErrorState, SkeletonCard, SkeletonTable, SegmentedControl, DateRangePicker, FilterBar, and MultiSelect, used for creating consistent user interface elements in a dashboard or application.

methods.name: Pill
methods.description: React component for a filter chip or status indicator with optional remove and click handlers.

methods.name: EmptyState
methods.description: React component for displaying a placeholder when no data or content is available.

methods.name: ErrorState
methods.description: React component for displaying an error message with a retry button.

methods.name: SkeletonCard
methods.description: React component that renders a loading placeholder resembling a content card.

methods.name: SkeletonTable
methods.description: React component that renders a loading placeholder resembling a table.

methods.name: SegmentedControl
methods.description: React component for a segmented button group, e.g., for selecting time ranges.

methods.name: DateRangePicker
methods.description: React component for selecting a date range using two date inputs.

methods.name: FilterBar
methods.description: React component that provides a layout for filters and active filter pills with clear-all functionality.

methods.name: MultiSelect
methods.description: React component for a multi-select dropdown with checkboxes.
